game.title: Alien: Isolation
game.blurb: First-person survival horror game from Creative Assembly (RAWG also lists SEGA and Feral Interactive), published by SEGA, released 2014-10-05. RAWG average playtime: 4 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters follow the missions counted in the Steam achievements.

chapters.title: Missions 1 to 7
chapters.summary: From waking up and reaching Sevastopol to An Outpost of Progress, and the first meeting with the Alien.

chapters.title: Missions 10 to 18
chapters.summary: From Bait to End of the Hunt, with three hidden mission achievements. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: ID Tags and Logs
chapters.summary: Collecting ID tags, archive logs and the Nostromo logs.

chapters.title: Tools, Crafting and Hacking
chapters.summary: Building items, hacks, minigames, rewire points, the motion tracker and the vents.

chapters.title: Difficulty and Challenges
chapters.summary: The hardest difficulty, finishing with no human kills or no deaths, Reactor Maintenance without dying, and other hidden feats.

chapters.title: Survival and Combat
chapters.summary: Using each weapon, fighting androids and humans, and driving the Alien back with fire.

StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Alien:_Isolation

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 3556). Steam app 214490 was used; its schema is named "ValveTestApp214490" and the store list confirms "Alien: Isolation". StrategyWiki has "Alien: Isolation" at completion stage 0: only Table of Contents is written; Walkthrough, Gameplay, Controls, Items, Weapons and the achievements page are linked but not written. avp.fandom.com answers the API under "Alien: Isolation" with about 194 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 7 of 50 Steam achievements are hidden. The mission achievements count missions up to the eighteenth, but the schema has none for the eighth or ninth; the three hidden progression ones (CA_PROGRESSION_13 to 15) sit between the thirteenth and seventeenth, so they were put in the later missions chapter, as was the hidden "Not the First" (CA_BEACON), a guess. Three hidden ones whose API names suggest challenges (CA_ALIENDEATHCOUNT, CA_M09_NOT_KILLED_BY_ALIEN, CA_COMPLETE_NODEATHS) sit in the challenges chapter. "Just out of Reach" (escape Comms without an android attack) is placed with the challenges because the data does not say which mission Comms is. RAWG lists nine add-ons (such as Crew Expendable, Last Survivor, Trauma and Safe Haven) and a Collection, but none of the 50 Steam achievements names them.
